notes.title: Row Away v1.3 updates
notes.content:
Row Away is now updated to v1.3 with some changes and updates:

[list]
[*] Some changes and updates on some audios
[*] Some changes and updates on some terrains
[*] Added some new obstacles 
[/list]

notes.title: Row Away is Out Now!
notes.content: [p]Row Away is out now ! [/p][p]It's time to grab your paddle, hop in your barrel, and Row away![/p][p][/p][p]New features and updates:[/p][list][*][p]Added player color customization[/p][/*][*][p]Added save features[/p][/*][*][p]Added new sfx and BGM[/p][/*][*][p]Added rewards for replayability[/p][/*][*][p]Added steam achievements[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the paddle mechanic- now the barrel will moves when you do a quick turn[/p][/*][*][p]Updated terrains and obstacles[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Coming in one week!
notes.content: [p]Row Away will be available on September 5 2025. Special thanks to all the players that played the demo and giving feedbacks about the game. In regard to the upcoming release of Row Away, the demo will be removed from the store because some differences on the final version and does not fully conveys the features from the final version. [/p][p]These are some changes that will be present on the final version:[/p][list][*][p]Added player color customization[/p][/*][*][p]Added save features[/p][/*][*][p]Added new sfx and BGM[/p][/*][*][p]Added rewards for replayability [/p][/*][*][p]Added steam achievements[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the paddle mechanic- now the barrel will moves when you do a quick turn[/p][/*][*][p]Updated terrains and obstacles[/p][/*][*][p]Some bug fixes[/p][/*][/list][p]I'll see you again next week![/p]
